<thought>To determine the connected fragments that compose the molecule, I need to see which carbons are directly attached to which hydrogens. The HSQC spectrum provides one‑bond ^1H–^13C correlations, allowing me to pair each carbon shift with its attached proton(s). This will let me infer how the carbons are linked and therefore define the fragments that can be joined to reconstruct the whole structure.</thought>
